hazards.evidence: Only one side of the staircase has a handrail, which could make it difficult for someone using a walker to maintain balance and support while ascending or descending the stairs.
There are visible cords or wires running across the walkway near the bottom of the stairs, posing a tripping hazard for someone using a walker.
The walkway near the bottom of the stairs appears to be somewhat narrowed due to the placement of furniture and the staircase itself, which could limit maneuverability for someone using a walker.
